page.title: Overview
page.purpose: Give operators a truthful command-center view of tunnel readiness, exposed routes, policy state, recovery risk, and the next actions that can change those states.

priorities.statement: Show the route topology and its operational evidence before aggregate success numbers.
Keep missing credentials and partial read failures scoped to the capability they affect.
Make every actionable finding lead to a route, settings, diagnostics, or recovery surface.

states.description: Tunnel, route, policy, classification, and recovery data are loading.
The constellation, route index, readiness summary, and findings are visible.
Some sources are unavailable while remaining route evidence stays visible and attributed.
The last known operational picture remains visible while refresh is pending.
Local operation remains available while remote reconciliation is blocked by missing credentials.
No exposed routes exist and the first exposure action explains the safety boundary.
A read failed and the affected source has a retry action.

regions.purpose: Render command-center readiness, tunnel, route, and recovery evidence through loading, ready, partial, and failed states.

claims.statement: The Overview page exposes a stable named main region.
Each displayed route node is derived from a route exposure and associated readiness evidence; decorative nodes are not presented as live routes.
